name: s2ar
displayName: s2ar — paid tools for agents, each with a receipt
description: assert an output (JSON schema, terms, citations, quotations found in a source; a signed record), inspect an x402 endpoint before paying it, grade a text against a form, certify an image — the hosted s2ar tools as MCP tools, free samples first, a $5 key or USDC per call after. Hooks only remind; every paid call is a tool you see.

api_key.title: s2ar key
api_key.description: Optional. A key from a $5 pack (https://s2ar.dev/mcp.html) or from signing in at https://api.s2ar.dev/login. Without one, each tool answers a few calls a day free; after that it answers with the price and how to pay.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: on (default): a line under an answer when it carries JSON that was not asserted, or names an x402 endpoint that was not inspected. off: no lines.
